notes.title: Toy Shop Simulator is Now Out of Early Access! 🎉
notes.content:
When we first opened the doors of our little toy shop, we never imagined how far this journey would take us. From humble beginnings with just a few shelves and toys, to thousands of players designing, decorating, and managing their dream stores—you made Toy Shop Simulator what it is today.

After countless updates, feedback sessions, laughs, and bug fixes, we're proud to say:
Toy Shop Simulator has officially left Early Access with our 1.0 Full Release!

But this milestone isn’t just about what we’ve added—it’s about everything we've built together as a community.

[b][h3]💡 Let’s take a look back at the journey so far:[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/cde5d4faa8fcd6a69506827cfaa535fd57bdeb58.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/63fd544dc884f2cfd411370a872db1832f5536b6.png[/img]


Whether you're a veteran shopkeeper or just stepping into Toyverse, there’s never been a better time to play.
Scroll down to see all the exciting new features in our 1.0 update!

[h1]🧩 What’s New in Version 1.0?[/h1]
[h3]🆕 New Story-Based Rival System[/h3]
Enter the Toy Shop Simulator world and take on a powerful rival toy store in our brand-new story-driven mode. Compete, expand, and prove who’s the real boss of the block!

In this new mode, you’ll face off against the rival’s employees in a series of skill-based versus challenges. Beat them one by one to climb the ranks—and when the time comes, challenge the rival boss in a final high-stakes showdown.

If you win? The Toyverse store becomes yours.
Your journey now has a story—and the future of your toy empire depends on your skills!

[h3]⚔️ Versus Challenges Added![/h3]
Compete in skill-based challenges and prove your toy shop supremacy:

[h3]Register Rumble – Fastest at checkout wins![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/013fd812c46c0d527581e48521cef57d8f091e8b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Trash Tussle – Who can clean the most mess?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/0a18f1adbfbcd5735bbe6afe68ff11c56099d51b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Delivery Duel – Pack and deliver orders with speed.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/56fe5eba3141caa9e6bca021c2f69015bab6ba86.jpg[/img]
[h3]Remote Rally – Race your RC car to victory![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/19177fa6bf5b049a8f17a04f5ed9c53e83a3a5de.jpg[/img]
[h3]Revenue Rumble – Beat your rival in daily profits![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/48af001d9eeffad3df1b8c8455d30c76d16ebc47.jpg[/img]
🏆 Win these battles to unlock new prizes on the Toy Collector Rack.
🏅 4 new achievements await those who dominate the versus mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/8d2a2fb5e92f1e3def0e8aa678ca23e908fdb2a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/77b418b2657a7b84210e716b00080cbd03ec296d.jpg[/img]

[h3]🧸 Tons of New Toys & Licenses![/h3]
Our shelves are now overflowing with even more fun:

Plushies & Large Plushies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/a4cf0088763adba978dbc91858e2ac1cb27a1f79.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/30893edaecd9121214263267d23eb72ef250faeb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/2b64d0b5ef986c4e617070b4ae3c334097038e96.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/ccf9a8dbd629e233e78b47492f99a6eddba6e412.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/35d3c82a0a38acdba92e1805b9ad81809cf6b4e4.png[/img]


[h3]Bikes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/2ab9577fe182ae7ad91a8009e097bad20a7d213c.jpg[/img]

...and many more surprises!

[h3]🆕 Two new racks added:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Large Plushie Rack
[*] Bike Rack
[/list]
📮 New Delivery Mailboxes added for online orders!
🏠 New Decorations & Paints
🎈 New decorative balloons, plushies, and carpets
🎨 20 new floor paints
🖌️ 3 additional wall paint options
🐞 Bug Fixes & Improvements
🧍‍♂️ Customer behavior bugs fixed
📦 Stocker-related issues resolved
🛠️ Improved feedback for invalid rack placement
🌍 Fixed several localization text problems
💵 Improved accuracy of cash checkout flow
🪑 Storage furniture now correctly saves placement

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/9c0ee750cf50784a8c3e0defb4f6ab988abf833a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/97a64c74d14f1b4234cca590499d8a0776958a31.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/4ed26afff0e904a52ec77a292e1afe118c1a1f92.jpg[/img]

To everyone who played during Early Access, reported bugs, shared suggestions, or just took the time to enjoy our game: thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Your passion helped shape every shelf, every mechanic, and every little toy on display.

If you’d like to be part of what comes next, we’d love to have you in our Discord community. That’s where we’ll be sharing sneak peeks, hosting playtests, and shaping our future games together with you. (We are already working on a new co-op game tho!)

Once again, thank you for growing this little toy shop with us. Your support made all of this possible.

notes.title: Major Update v0.4.0b3: Shoplifters, Special Collection Toys and many more!
notes.content:
[h2]🌸 Spring is here, and so is a major update! 🌸[/h2]

Hello, Toy Merchants! 🧸 The Spring Sale is in full swing, and we’re celebrating with a huge update packed with exciting new features, gameplay improvements, and surprises for all toy shop owners! From playable Legendary toys to a brand-new vending machine and case-opening system, this update brings fresh ways to expand and personalize your store.

But beware! Rival shops are now sending sneaky shoplifters to steal from you. Stay sharp, catch them in the act, and protect your valuable stock! 🚨

Plus, to make things even better, Toy Shop Simulator is 20% off for a limited time! There’s never been a better time to start your journey as the ultimate toy tycoon! 🚀

[h2]🚀 What's new? [/h2]

[h3]Playable Legendary Special Toys[/h3]
 If there’s one thing more fun than selling toys, it’s playing with them! We heard you, and now certain toys—their Legendary versions—are fully playable! Fly a toy plane around your shop, bounce a basketball, or even make some annoying sounds with a rubber duck! 🏀🐤✈️ Have fun!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hk5WKou.gif[/img]

[h3]Say hello to your new Spiral Vending Machine![/h3] 
We've introduced a brand-new vending machine that both customers and the player can interact with! This machine dispenses toys using a spiral mechanism, adding a fun and dynamic twist to shopping. Try your luck and win [b]rare and exclusive toys![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fiuH2Yi.gif[/img]

[h3]Case Opening System[/h3]
We've added five different cases: [i]Basic, Standard, Premium, Elite, and Legendary![/i]
 Each case contains a unique selection of toys with varying drop rates for rare and exclusive items. Perfect for toy collectors looking to expand their collection at great prices! 🎁✨

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JKTsoxr.gif[/img]

[h3]Brand new Special Toy Collector Rack[/h3]
A special rack designed for collectors to showcase their rare and valuable toys. 
Can you collect them all and create the ultimate display of exclusive toys? 🏆

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o4nBh0e.gif[/img]

[h3]Shoplifters [/h3]
Watch out! Toyverse is now sending sneaky shoplifters to steal from your shop. Stay vigilant and catch them before they get away with your valuable toys! 🚨🕵️‍♂️

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m5iF3Zh.gif[/img]

[h3]Cash Register Customization [/h3]
From now on, you can customize your cash register’s appearance to match your store’s unique style.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dxiNgI5.gif[/img]

[b]Price Tag Removal[/b] – Now you can remove price tags to adjust your product displays more freely.
[b]New Jammer Car Movement[/b] – Improved movement for the Jammer Car, making it more dynamic and realistic.

🎵 Audio
[list]
[*] Updated SFX for NPC box interaction.
[*] Updated SFX for NPC mop interaction.
[/list]

🧠 AI & NPC Behavior
[list]
[*] Stocker now checks previously dropped boxes to place items back.
[*] Fixed issue where stocker would randomly stock items.
[*] Fixed a bug where the cashier would stop working.
[*] Various customer-related bugs fixed.
[/list]

🛠️ Placement & Decoration
[list]
[*] General placement improvements.
[*] Decoration placing mode adjusted.
[/list]

📦 Environment & UI
[list]
[*] Warehouse racks' colliders adjusted.
[*] Fixed a visual bug in the wholesaler product UI text.
[/list]

🚶 Navigation & Collisions
[list]
[*] Customers now keep more distance when walking around racks.
[*] Rack colliders have been adjusted for smoother navigation.
[*] Warehouse racks' colliders adjusted.
[/list]

[h3]🌸 Spring Sale – 20% Off! 🌸 [/h3]
 To celebrate the Spring Sale, Toy Shop Simulator is now 20% off for a limited time! Don’t miss this chance to build your dream toy shop at a discounted price! 🎉

[h3]That’s all for now, Toy Merchants! We’re excited for you to experience these updates and bring your store to life. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy selling![/h3]

notes.title: Major Update v0.3.0b7: New Features, Bug Fixes, and Stockers!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Toy Merchants! 🧸[/h1]

[h2]We’re excited to share a major update for Toy Shop Simulator![/h2]

[h3]In this exciting update for Toy Shop Simulator, we’ve added new features, including the Stocker employee to help manage your shelves, the ability to place toys in boxes, and new visual updates for the Online Order Box. We’ve also made several gameplay improvements, such as better interactions with colliders and the Warm Wheels Set 2 background update. Plus, we’ve fixed key bugs to enhance your overall experience. And stay tuned for more, as we’re adding exclusive collector’s toys and new displays in the next update!

Here’s the full breakdown of what’s new and improved:[/h3]

[h2]🚀 What's new? [/h2]

[h3]Say hello to your new employee Stockers![/h3] 

A new employee type has been added! The Stocker will help you keep your shelves filled, automatically restocking products so you can focus on growing your business. Hire one to streamline your store management!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/E2Ba7OG.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Toys on the floor can now be placed in a box.
[*] Toys in your hand can now be placed in a box.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tL64pAh.gif[/img]

You can now drop boxes in place using the G button.
Visual update: The Online Order box now features new VFX and pink foam for added detail.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/e7e1d14b41ffcfdb8aae0d22e20203613bf6dc2d.png[/img]

[h2]⚖️ Features & Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Online order review delete added.
[*] The Warm Wheels Set 2 background has been updated, making it stand out more distinctly from the other sets.
[*] OnlineOrderBox contains toy's scaling and Y-offset adjusted.
[*] WarmWheels name update WarmTires model, texture, and UI updated. 
[*] GameStation decoration unlock level adjusted.
[*] RoombaBot movement area updated and improved.
[/list]

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]

In this update, we've fixed several key issues to improve gameplay. From collider improvements to customer notifications, we've worked to enhance your experience and ensure smoother interactions. Here’s a quick overview of the fixes:
[list]
[*] Hanging Rack collider improvement for better interactions.
[*] Warehouse Shelf collider improvement for better interactions.
[*] Scooter shop entry arrow visibility issue fixed.
[*] Tutorial cash register exit issue fixed.
[*] Grandpa Letter issue fixed.
[*] Customer departure time after 21:00 has been adjusted. After level 15, customers will no longer leave the shop.
[*] The logic for "Customer Products Not Found" has been improved. (We will continue monitoring this.)
[*] The product item shelf count and box count data issue in the Wholesaler section (?) icon has been fixed.
[*] The Paint Bucket placing mode no longer appears when placing mode is active and disabled.
[*] The issue with receiving customer notifications at the cash register while being at the register has been fixed.
[/list]

[h2]We’ve updated our Credits page! Moving forward, we will be regularly updating it.[/h2]
A huge thank you to our community for your continued support and contributions! Special thanks to our voluntarily translators for helping bring the game to a wider audience. Your hard work means the world to us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/6eee94e9b84abf2587eec041fc20ffc7fa246170.png[/img]

[h2]👉 UPCOMING[/h2]

We're adding exclusive collector’s toys to the game! Additionally, we’re bringing a new shelf to the Boss Room so you can display these special toys. Legendary toys will also become available for in-game use.  (Yes, you can play it!!!!) The next update will be incredibly exciting for collectors and anyone who loves hunting for rare toys!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ngykTm2.gif[/img]

[h3]That’s all for now, Toy Merchants! We’re excited for you to experience these updates and bring your store to life. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy selling![/h3]

notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Toy Merchants! 🧸[/h1]

[h2]We’re excited to share a major update for Toy Shop Simulator![/h2]

[h3]This patch brings a host of new features, including a brand-new cashier system, the introduction of the helpful Roomba Bot, and a variety of new NPC models to enhance your shop's atmosphere. Alongside these, we’ve squashed a significant number of critical bugs, improved game performance, and refined several mechanics to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience.

[h3]Meet the Roomba Bot![/h3]

Your shop’s new cleaning companion has arrived! The Roomba Bot tirelessly keeps your store spotless, ensuring a tidy and welcoming environment for your customers. Say goodbye to cleaning hassles and let this trusty robot handle the mess!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YG1yHXZ.gif[/img]

[h3]Steam Achievements Are Here![/h3]

We’ve added a variety of Steam achievements to enhance your gameplay experience! Whether you’re managing your store like a pro, unlocking new features, or reaching key milestones, there’s now even more to strive for. Track your progress, show off your accomplishments, and add an extra layer of challenge and fun to your Toy Shop Simulator journey!

[list]
[*] Rack placement colliders have been adjusted for improved functionality.
[*] Blindman Montecup game level increased from 3 to 6, with gameplay speed adjusted for a more dynamic experience.
[*] Kawaii toys shelf capacity has been increased 6 --> 12 to enhance inventory management.
[*] Cursor size reduced from 20 to 10 for a more user-friendly experience.
[*] Level of Detail (LOD) added to toys to optimize performance.
[*] NPC textures updated for improved visual quality.
[*] Blindman model has been updated with animations.
[*] Balls physics behavior refined for smoother interactions.
[*] Agent behavior logic enhanced to improve NPC performance.
[*] General improvements made to game data handling.
[/list]

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]

In this update, we’ve addressed several critical bugs to enhance the overall gameplay experience. From resolving issues with skaterack functionality to fixing agent movement and menu button bugs, we've worked hard to ensure smoother gameplay and improved system stability. Here's a detailed look at the fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs related to skaterack functionality.
[*] Resolved update canvas issues with product boxes and furniture boxes.
[*] Addressed bugs in register and product item interactions.
[*] Menu button functionality bugs have been resolved.
[*] Fixed agent movement issues for smoother gameplay.
[*] General warnings have been addressed, improving overall system stability.
[*] Financial data saving issues have been resolved.
[*] Decoration highlight bugs fixed.
[/list]

As a small indie team, every game we create is a labor of love, and we’re excited to bring [b]Insight [/b]and [b]Toy Shop Simulator[/b] together in one special bundle. notes.title: Devlog #3: Customization and Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Have a great week, Toy Merchants! 🐼[/h1]

[i]We’re back with our third devlog, and this time we’re diving into the exciting new customization options and game improvements we’ve added to Toy Shop Simulator. These updates are designed to enhance your experience, give you more control over your shop’s personality, and make gameplay smoother and more engaging. Let’s break it all down:[/i]

[b][h2]Polished In-Game UI[/h2][/b]
We’ve updated the player interface and refined pop-up notifications for a cleaner, more cohesive look. These updates make the overall experience more intuitive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/0d6d825738e2227f361cb3152674509a4425932d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/65dd0497ab7fc7c612b31d61a9b852839dd2ff21.png[/img]

[h2][b]Wall Painting with Paint Buckets[/b][/h2]
Express your creativity! You can now paint your shop walls using a variety of colorful paint buckets. Choose from a range of colors and patterns to make your toy shop stand out and reflect your unique style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/e20c144a01af05eda45733e2d324763134e1e774.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Shop Signboards[/b][/h2]

To complement the naming system, we’ve added a collection of new signboards. These come in various styles and designs to ensure your shop’s exterior looks as inviting as possible.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gpuh22f.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Decorations and Racks[/b][/h2]
Take your shop’s interior to the next level with a plethora of new decorations and racks. From charming ornaments to practical shelving, these additions will make your shop feel more vibrant and functional.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/1d263ae72f15d599b484a70c01eef5d1ee878869.png[/img]

[h2][b]Enhanced Toy Interaction[/b][/h2]
Based on your feedback from the demo, we’ve added the ability to pick up toys! You can now move them individually, drop them on the floor, and rearrange them however you like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/bca16842b62f1d8efe3c5f3af5cff1dd501eacf9.png[/img]

[h2][b]Introducing the Warehouse System[/b][/h2]
As your business grows, so does the need for storage. That’s why we’ve implemented a warehouse system! Now you can stockpile toys in your warehouse and replenish your shelves as needed, ensuring that you’re always prepared for the busiest of days.

[h2][b]Beginner Friendly Tutorial System[/b][/h2]
Based on your feedback from the demo, we’ve improved the tutorial system to better guide new players. With clearer instructions and more interactive elements, you’ll feel right at home in no time.

[h2][b]Save Backup System[/b][/h2]
We know how frustrating it is to lose progress after encountering a bug, especially after hours of work. That’s why we’re working on improving our save backup system. Our goal is to ensure no one has to rearrange their shelves twice!

[h2][b]New Game for Blindman[/b][/h2]
Blindman is back with a new mini-game! Test your skills and enjoy a fresh challenge as you immerse yourself in this latest addition.

[h3]That’s all for this devlog. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy selling![/h3]

[h2]THANK YOU <3
[/h2]

notes.title: Devlog#2: Customers – Bringing the Store to Life
notes.content:
[h1]Hello again, Toy Merchants! 🚂[/h1]

[i]We’re thrilled to present our second devlog, and this time it’s all about the lifeblood of your toy shop: the [b]customers[/b]. From playful children to meticulous shoppers, we’ve added new layers of interaction and personality to make your store feel more alive than ever before. Let’s dive into what’s new and improved![/i]

[b][h2]New Customer Models – Welcome the Little Shoppers![/h2][/b]
We’ve introduced a variety of new customer models, including children who now eagerly browse your shelves for the perfect toy. Watch as they light up with excitement while exploring your shop, or pout when they can’t get their favorite toy. These little shoppers bring a lively and heartwarming touch to the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/6a68688e5e2615423b9a746fd0d06b460bb2fd74.png[/img]

[h2][b]Queue Up – The Storefront Experience[/b][/h2]
Customers now queue outside your shop when it’s closed, eagerly waiting for the doors to open. Whether it’s the rush of a sale or the allure of a beautifully decorated store, they’ll be ready to storm in once you open for business.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5eMSwvC.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Reactive Shoppers – Actions Speak Louder[/b][/h2]
Customers have become more reactive than ever before, responding to various in-store events:
[list]
[*] Price Changes: Customers will cheer for discounts or grumble if prices spike.
[*] Wrong Change: Accidentally shortchange someone? Expect frustration!
[*] Shelf Interactions: Removing a product while they’re browsing? They’ll definitely let you know how they feel.
[*] Mop Mishaps: Annoy customers with excessive mopping, and they might just walk out.
[*] End-of-Day Tantrums: At closing time, customers now throw their toys on the floor as they leave.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G19A5Do.gif[/img]


[h2][b]Dynamic Reactions and Dialogues[/b][/h2]
Customers comment while picking products off the shelves, sharing thoughts like, “[i]This would be perfect for my kid![/i]” They even react to sabotage events and engage in daily small talk, making every interaction feel unique and immersive.

[h2][b]Improved Animations – More Expressive and Fun[/b][/h2]
We’ve polished customer animations to make their actions more fluid and entertaining. For example, if you toss a box at a shopper’s head (oops!), they’ll stumble and react accordingly. These little details add humor and charm to your shop’s bustling environment.

[b][h2]Customer Morale – Keep Them Happy![/h2][/b]
Each customer now has a morale meter that reflects their shopping experience. Here’s how it works:
Positive Influences: Beautiful decorations and a clean shop boost morale.
Negative Influences: Long queues, dirty floors, or not finding what they’re looking for will lower morale.
Keeping customers happy is key to building a loyal clientele and ensuring your toy shop becomes the neighborhood’s favorite destination.

[h3]That’s all for this devlog, Toy Merchants! We’re excited for you to experience these updates and bring your store to life. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy selling![/h3]

[h2]THANK YOU <3
[/h2]

notes.title: Devlog#1: The Journey of Toy Merchants Begins!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Toy Merchants! 🧸[/h1]

It feels like yesterday we launched the demo for Toy Shop Simulator. Your excitement, feedback, and passion have fueled us like never before. Today, we’re thrilled to present our very first devlog as we march toward the release of our Early Access version on January 13th.

This journey has been an emotional rollercoaster. Every bug squashed, every feature added, and every piece of feedback received reminded us why we’re doing this: to create a game that brings joy, challenge, and a touch of mischief to your screens.

Since the demo, we’ve worked tirelessly to craft new features, polish existing mechanics, and breathe more life into the world of Toy Shop Simulator. This game is as much yours as it is ours, and we can’t wait for you to experience all the updates and changes we’ve made.

Here’s a sneak peek at what’s new in your journey to becoming the ultimate Toy Merchant. let’s dive into some updates that breathe new life into Toy Shop Simulator.

[h2][b]Toyverse and the War of Shops[/b][/h2]
Toyverse isn’t just a name; it’s a formidable force in the toy-selling world. You start the game as a hardworking employee at Toyverse, struggling to make ends meet. Despite your dedication, your boss fires you without warning, leaving you unable to pay your rent and forcing you to spend the night on a park bench. But as dawn breaks, you receive a message and a key from your grandfather. He shares the story of how he once ran one of the most beloved toy shops in the neighborhood, only to close it down when he couldn’t compete with the rising power of Toyverse. Now, he entrusts you with the mission of reviving the shop and restoring the neighborhood’s golden days. Will you rise to the challenge and become the community’s favorite toy merchant?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157933/a627082560e69a3b34bfde2d77951bfd30f054eb.png[/img]

[h2][b]Rival and Chaos – Introducing Sabotage Mechanics![/b][/h2]
Competing in the toy business means staying sharp and sometimes playing dirty. Toyverse, the reigning franchise, is relentless in its mission to crush any competition. That’s where sabotage comes in! Let’s introduce you to three playful yet devious mechanics to help you level the playing field:

First, meet the [b]Jammer Remote Car.[/b] This handy little gadget lets you sneak into your rival’s territory and disrupt their internet. No Wi-Fi means no online orders—the perfect way to throw a wrench in their plans! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yrkc3Xs.gif[/img]

Next, it’s time to unleash the [b]Fuse Box Frenzy[/b]. Armed with a trusty screwdriver, you can sabotage your rival’s electrical box and plunge their shop into darkness. No lights, no sales—just pure chaos! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vOy1nDq.gif[/img]

Finally, bring in the big guns with [b]Garbage Truck Mayhem.[/b] Arrange for a garbage truck to dump a heap of trash right in front of their pristine storefront. Nothing says “shop elsewhere” quite like the stench of sabotage!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZTktzYz.gif[/img]

These quirky mechanics not only bring strategy but also add a touch of humor to the cutthroat world of toy retail. Remember, though, Toyverse won’t sit idly by. It’s a battle of wits and wiles—are you ready to take them on?

[h3]FEEL FREE TO JOIN OUR DISCORD[/h3]
